mechanics.claim: Nilah cannot basic attack or cast her other abilities while channeling Apotheosis, but can move.
mechanics.quote: '''Nilah''' is unable to basic attack and cast her other [[champion ability|abilities]] during Apotheosis, but she is able to move.

mechanics.claim: A spell shield will only block the burst damage instance, not the channel ticks.
mechanics.quote: {{tip|Spell shield}} will only block the burst damage.

mechanics.claim: The channel deals physical damage to nearby enemies every 0.25 seconds for about 1 second before the burst fires.
mechanics.quote: '''Nilah''' whirls her whip-blade over 1 second, dealing {{as|physical damage}} to nearby enemies every {{fd|0.25}} seconds.

mechanics.claim: Nilah heals herself and nearby allied champions for a portion of post-mitigation damage dealt to champions during Apotheosis, converting overhealing beyond max health into a shield.
mechanics.quote: '''Nilah''' {{tip|heals}} herself and nearby allied champions for {{pp|key=%|key1=%|type=critical strike chance|20 to 50 for 11|0 to 100|formula=20% + 0.3% per 1% critical strike chance, capped at 100% critical strike chance|color=critical chance}} of the {{tt|post-mitigation damage|Damage calculated after modifiers}} dealt to {{tip|champions}}
